notes.title: We hit 30K wishlists for Eden’s Guardian!
notes.content:
Eden's Guardian has surpassed the 30K wishlists on Steam! We’re incredibly humbled by all the support, when this all started, we weren’t expecting we would get this far in such a short time. Thank you so much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/bd62ccccca862c017276970cf64659260287cd90.gif[/img]

We want to let you know that this is only the beginning of the journey, as we will be working very hard on Eden’s Guardian and focusing on development in the coming months, and we will be showing you how the game progresses to make you a part of the process. You can follow us on social media or join our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/7jkCyzXaEW]Discord server[/url][/b] to stay tuned with everything!

We hope we will continue reaching ever bigger goals in the near future with you by our side! And that’s why we wanted to show our appreciation for all of you with [b][url=https://twitter.com/voragineGS_/status/1780989162805473558]this post[/url][/b]. We hope you’ll like it!

See you soon with more news!

notes.title: EDEN’S GUARDIAN IS NOW LIVE ON KICKSTARTER!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! The time has finally come! The [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/voraginegs/edens-guardian-a-dark-fantasy-pixel-art-metroidvania]Kickstarter[/url][/b] campaign of Eden’s Guardian is [b]LIVE[/b]! We are so excited for you to finally see all the stuff we’ve prepared!

First of all, we have an awesome [b]animated trailer[/b] for the campaign produced by none other than [b]Sunshine Animation Studio[/b]! We couldn’t be happier with the result, and we hope you’ll like it too! We’ve worked hard to showcase everything Eden’s Guardian has to offer.

[previewyoutube=9lXWyLphmSo;full][/previewyoutube]

On the Kickstarter you’ll also find all kinds of [b]exclusive rewards[/b]! These include a [b]Limited Collector's Edition[/b] with an exclusive Kickstarter inlay, a 12cms tall high-quality [b]statue of the Guardian[/b], [b]in-game rewards[/b] that will allow players to become [b]part of the lore[/b] of the game, and many other digital and physical items!

Head there to check everything out and support us if you like what you see! And don’t forget you can help us a lot by spreading the word as well.

Thank you for your support, we hope you'll accompany us in this journey!

notes.title: The Kickstarter campaign of Eden's Guardian kicks off on March 26th!
notes.content:
After a lot of work, we can finally announce that the [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/voraginegs/edens-guardian-a-dark-fantasy-pixel-art-metroidvania]Kickstarter[/url][/b] campaign of Eden's Guardian will kick off on [b]March 26th[/b]! Make sure you mark your calendars! We hope we'll get as many people as possible to accompany us on our journey.

We will have some limited and exclusive rewards, as well as early birds, so remember you can sign up by clicking on the [b]“Notify me on launch”[/b] button if you don't want to miss out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/340fc8cca7b1e6c5318ba7b23b8a9ad36dc97b4e.gif[/img]

We're preparing many surprises that will be revealed during the campaign, and we can't wait to show it all to you. There will be new scenearios or enemies like this one that can stop your teleport ability. How will you fight against it?

Thank you all for your support and see you on March 26th for the start of our campaign!

notes.title: THE #NOHITCHALLENGE OF EDEN'S GUARDIAN IS HERE!
notes.content:
Hello, guardians!

The [b]No Hit Challenge[/b] of Eden's Guardian is here! We summon you from the forsaken lands of Eden’s Guardian, where an ominous conflict rends the veil between deities and mortals. You must [b]confront[/b] Argoth, The Eternal Sentinel, from the end of our [b]demo[/b], [b]without taking any damage[/b]! If you're able to do so, you'll receive an [b]exclusive digital asset[/b] for your own use!

All you have to do is play the [b]demo[/b] of Eden's Guardian here on Steam, record your gaming session and upload a [b]clip[/b] or do a [b]live streaming[/b] defeating the boss without taking any hits and [b]tag us on social media[/b]!

Are you ready to take on the challenge? It’s your turn now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589980/Edens_Guardian/

notes.title: Eden’s Guardian teleports to the Ravenage Metroidvania Festival with its demo!
notes.content:
Eden’s Guardian joins the Ravenage Metroidvania Festival on Steam with its demo! From March 4th to March 11th we will be part of it and celebrate the genre together with many other amazing games.
 
We’re really happy to be participating and seeing Eden’s Guardian reach even more people, since we’re at a crucial time for the project right now. After working hard on our demo, we’re in the final steps of getting ready for our [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/voraginegs/edens-guardian-a-dark-fantasy-pixel-art-metroidvania]Kickstarter[/url] campaign[/b], so we hope many people will join us in our journey!

Play the demo of Eden’s Guardian and check out all the cool stuff we have coming soon to the game! And make sure to enjoy all the other awesome games participating in the festival, to take advantage of the sales and to play all the demos available.

Have fun and see you very soon with more exciting news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589980/Edens_Guardian/

notes.title: EDEN'S GUARDIAN HAS A NEW COVER ART!
notes.content:
We're very happy to show you the [b]new cover art[/b] for Eden's Guardian illustrated by the awesome artist [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/alvarojh.0/]Álvaro Jiménez[/url][/b]! We wanted to give you a glimpse of what we truly aspire to do with this project, and we believe he's done an incredible job of capturing its essence. It's a big surprise that we had been saving before our Kickstarter campaign starts, so we hope you'll like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/717e34582be1ff24468ba3fcf1a898ea1b5177d8.png[/img]

If this makes you more excited for our upcoming [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/voraginegs/edens-guardian-a-dark-fantasy-pixel-art-metroidvania]Kickstarter[/url][/b], remember you can follow the campaign, and if you sign up for our [b][url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/f9a37720-85ea-4331-9bb0-ab49d829de01/landing]newsletter[/url][/b], you'll get an [b]exclusive limited skin[/b] for the guardian for free when the game launches.

That's all for now! Enjoy the new art and see you soon!

notes.title: Get an Exclusive free coloured-skin for your Guardian!
notes.content:
Hey, Guardians, we have just launched this awesome promo and we want you to be part of it. It's very easy, all you have to do is Sign Up [b][url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/f9a37720-85ea-4331-9bb0-ab49d829de01/landing]here[/url][/b] and you will receive an Exclusive coloured-skin for Eden's Guardian on release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/c5a6e0a3acf7b96603f4930b559e74915dc5e35a.png[/img]

After you sign up, you can also help us spread the news with your followers and friends by sharing with them this [b][url=https://twitter.com/VoragineGS/status/1758487230685843496]post[/url][/b] or the link to the page where you signed up.

And that's not all! Those who sign up will be the first ones to know everything about our upcoming Kickstarter campaign, having special access to all the info on the exclusive and limited items and promotions that will be available only during the campaign.

We're eager to show everything that we're working on! Thank you so much for the support here on Steam and on our social channels. The journey has been amazing so far and we can't wait for what's to come!

notes.title: Come defeat the first boss of Eden's Guardian with us on a new livestream!
notes.content:
The developers of Eden's Guardian will be playing through the demo again! If you want to see how a developer plays through the game and want to learn more about the idea and the process behind it, come hang out with us! 

We'll be fighting the boss and explaining things about the game, as well as answering your questions and chatting with you. Don't miss out!

See you at 1PM PT / 4PM ET / 9PM GMT / 10PM CET

notes.content:

If you try the demo and like the game, don’t forget to [b]wishlist it[/b] and to spread the word!

notes.content:
Eden’s Guardian is part of the Steam Next Fest with a [b]brand new demo[/b]! From February 5th to February 12th you can play an improved version of our old demo that will also include something new many of you anticipated: a BOSS BATTLE! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/05acdcd2f2e72a82e8544af2fcc14f33c894c9e7.gif[/img]

Ever since we released our first demo, we’ve received a lot of support and we couldn’t be more grateful for it. We’ve been working to incorporate the feedback we received, and with this we hope you’ll be able to enjoy Eden’s Guardian to the fullest during this Next Fest!

If you try the demo and like the game, don’t forget to [b]wishlist it[/b] and to spread the word!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589980/Edens_Guardian/

notes.title: THE KICKSTARTER PAGE OF EDEN’S GUARDIAN IS NOW OPEN!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

As you can see, we’re going to launch a [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/voraginegs/edens-guardian-a-dark-fantasy-pixel-art-metroidvania]Kickstarter[/url] campaign[/b] very soon for Eden’s Guardian, and the page is now open so you can [b]follow it and get notified when it starts[/b]!

In the last few months, we’ve been working hard preparing for this big moment, and we’d like you to be there with us. That’s why, even though the campaign hasn’t started yet, it would help us a lot if you clicked that [b]“Notify me on launch”[/b] button so you know when the campaign goes live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/fbc23d338d09bf315d29b9c2e4dacc3d95db2e78.gif[/img]

We’re still finishing up all the details, but we can assure you that the campaign is going to be amazing! We’re very excited to share with you all the rewards and cool stuff you’ll be able to get if you back the campaign.

Also, in just a few days, we’ll be part of the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] with a [b]BRAND NEW DEMO[/b]! As you can see the next couple of months are gonna be huge for Eden’s Guardian! This wouldn’t be possible without your support, and we hope we can continue achieving new goals with you going forward.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589980/Edens_Guardian/

notes.title: THE DEMO OF EDEN’S GUARDIAN IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
If after watching our latest trailer you found yourself wanting to know more about the mysterious world of Eden’s Guardian… We have good news for you, because a demo is now available! Thanks to everyone who’s been supporting us and asking to try the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/d5bcb3509f15f7388afc3c847adf57b4f2694524.png[/img]

Now you can try for yourself the unique powers of our protagonist’s sword! Unlock abilities and nail the sword on surfaces, throw it around and teleport to it! You’ll get to experience first-hand all the possibilities it can offer in both combat and exploration. 

Put yourself in the shoes of our guardian, immerse yourself in this intriguing and devastated world, and enjoy its enveloping atmosphere. And if you like it, remember that you can add it to your wishlist to stay tuned for all news related to the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589980/Edens_Guardian/

notes.title: Eden’s Guardian reveals a new trailer!
notes.content:
We’re very happy to share with you a brand new trailer of Eden’s Guardian with content that has never been shown before! Go watch it now and don’t miss out and all the new stuff we’ve added.

[previewyoutube=L1kzvtQc0sg;full][/previewyoutube]

In this trailer you can see new areas, new enemies, new animations and an overall more polished experience that we plan on improving and expanding even more! If you want to stay updated on all the news of Eden’s Guardian, remember to wishlist the game and follow us on social media. We have more exciting news coming soon, including a public demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589980/Edens_Guardian/

notes.title: Welcome to the world of Eden!
notes.content:
From the depths of a fantastical world comes Eden’s Guardian, a new and fresh metroidvania experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/2ae581c323f03fe93ead51efcaf6163ad68a94cf.png[/img]

We, Voragine Game Studio, are proud to finally present to you all this Steam Page and the opening of Wishlists.

If you like challenging metroidvania and epic boss fights or beautifully hand crafted pixel art, this is your game! We can assure you it won’t be easy to beat but you will have a lot of fun along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/54a956b9eb6d685168b1488800789a1860e47806.png[/img]

And if you’re looking for new experiences in the genre, our protagonist has a sword that she can nail in all surfaces and enemies and teleport to! You’ll be able to use his ability to both fight enemies and explore the vast and rich world of Eden’s Guardian, opening up many new ways to interact with your surroundings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599049/a9ad450248fd3698218c3a172292934a703140b4.png[/img]

Where shadow falls, it begins. Make sure to add the game to your wishlist to stay tuned with all the news regarding it. Join our protagonist now in her journey to bring back the light to the world of Eden!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589980/Edens_Guardian/
